name: sine-drift-3d
description: A 3D retro arcade runner in under 3KB Data URI with procedural audio and undulating sine terrain.

scripts.dev: node -e "import('http').then(h => h.createServer((req, res) => { res.writeHead(200, {'Content-Type': 'text/html'}); res.end(require('fs').readFileSync('dist/one-line-game.html')); }).listen(8080, () => console.log('Running on http://localhost:8080')));"
